rotation: Sort valid Cxx IDs; offset=1+int(sha256(protocol:user:trajectory:condition),16)%(N-1); map ID[i] to ID[(i+offset)%N]. No target, predictions or seed search.
personal6: First six rows of accepted personal memory; must equal personal rows in accepted fixed fusion.
personal_rebound: Copy accepted personal rows; replace every candidate_id using rotation; keep source, numeric values and order unchanged.
fusion_population_rebound: Copy accepted fixed fusion; rotate candidate_id only for population rows; personal rows unchanged.
length_failure: Stop before generation; do not search other offsets, pad, truncate or silently change protocol.
cache_policy: Reuse old response only for the same phase/user/trajectory and byte-identical messages plus identical token fingerprint. Record original condition and response-file hash. Empty-source unchanged prompts are retained, not removed.
decoding: Reuse frozen memory_reader_v1.json, exact model metadata, template, FP16 batch1 greedy and strict parser.
multiplicity: Exact paired discordant test; Holm over four Acc1 comparisons separately per phase. No pooled phase test.
denominators: All 400 fit / 200 development users, including invalid responses, absent target and null interventions.
secondary: Report changed-row counts, null interventions, format success, per-condition actual input/output tokens, and descriptive results for non-null interventions; no additional significance claims.
interpretation: Controls probe correctness of candidate-evidence association and personal row budget, not comprehensive understanding, habitual drift, or deployable routing. Rebinding can change source agreement and semantic plausibility.
next_gate: CPU prompt seals and independent perturbation validation; control runner/cache/evaluator implementation and verification; fresh GPU gate before inference. Do not alter old runner or old outputs.
